name: Sentry for AI (Sentry skills and plugins)
summary: Sentry's official skill library teaching coding agents to set up Sentry SDKs, triage production issues, fix Seer review comments and configure alerts, AI monitoring and OTel.
description: Source repo for Sentry's agent skills, built into an Agent Plugins 1.0 package and per-client plugins (`getsentry/plugin-claude`, `plugin-cursor`, `plugin-codex`, `plugin-copilot`, `plugin-antigravity`, `plugin-grok`); install one of those rather than this repo. The skills are also served over HTTP at skills.sentry.dev (entry points `/instrument`, `/workflows`, `/features`, `/cloudflare`) for agents to fetch with `curl -sL`. Pairs with Sentry's MCP server for querying issues. Separate from `getsentry/skills` (Apache-2.0), the internal engineering skills Sentry staff use for code review, commits and PRs.

agent_access.notes: Skill files are public: fetch https://skills.sentry.dev/ and follow relative links. Using Sentry itself needs a Sentry account.
